answer_1.quote: Abstractive summarization aims to produce a summary that concisely expresses key points of the input document rather than merely extracting pieces of it.

answer_2.quote: We report BLEU, ROUGE-1 (R1), ROUGE-2 (R2), and ROUGE-L (RL). We report the average of these four metrics as it generally shows the semantic similarities between generations and references.

answer_4.quote: We conduct human evaluations for three models: NNM-t2t, hybrid model, and hybrid model (oracle). To evaluate two key aspects of SUMMSCREEN, namely events and characters relationships, we ask human annotators two questions.
answer_4.guideline: The first is "Do the predicates in the generation match the predicates in the reference?" The second is "When multiple characters are mentioned as being related in some way in the generated recap, are those same characters mentioned as being related in some way in the reference?"
